Fintech startup Orbit raises $40 million

By Jo Park, November 12, 2026

Orbit, a Lisbon-based payments startup, said on Thursday it raised $40 million in a Series B round led by Northgate Capital.

The company, which was founded in 2020, says it processes “more than €2 billion” in transactions a year and employs 120 people.

Chief executive Ana Silva called the result “a transformational milestone for the industry”.
